We officially kicked off our Lightning Developer Bootcamp Yesterday in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania! 🇹🇿

It was an inspiring start as we welcomed a passionate group of developers eager to learn, build, and contribute to the future of Bitcoin and the Lightning Network in Africa.

Day 1 was all about going back to the basics. We explored the fundamentals of money - what money is, why it matters, and how Bitcoin is redefining it. candidates.text: ChapSmart is a Bitcoin payment service made for Tanzania. It lets you send Bitcoin using the Lightning Network and have it arrive instantly as Tanzanian Shillings straight into M-Pesa — or use it to pay bills directly, like we just talked about. No bank needed, no long waits, and fees are tiny compared to regular money transfer services. It's built to make Bitcoin genuinely useful for everyday Tanzanians, not just something you hold and watch the price of. Simple, fast, and practical money movement.
